title: io: reject zero capacity in BufReader
body:
## Motivation

A zero-length `BufReader` buffer makes `AsyncBufRead` operations report end-of-file while the underlying reader still has data. `BufStream::with_capacity` inherits the same problem through its reader capacity.

## Solution

Panic when `BufReader::with_capacity` receives zero, as requested in review. Document the panic on both constructors. Nonzero capacities retain their existing behavior.

## Validation

- Both constructor panic tests fail against the prior PR head and pass with the guard. All 12 buffered-reader tests pass, including one-byte reads and `copy_buf`.
- `cargo test -p tokio --features full -- --skip fifo_multiple_writes`: 2,202 passed, 67 ignored; baseline was 2,200 passed, 67 ignored. The unmodified-head run hung in `net_unix_pipe::fifo_multiple_writes`, so that one existing test was explicitly skipped in both completed runs.
- `rustfmt --check --edition 2021` passed for all 799 tracked Rust files.
- `cargo clippy -p tokio --features full --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
